_about: t22 stage B (card experiments/t22_student_encoder): t21_pair4.json (t21_pair4: the t21 one-frame pair chain, warm start runs/t20_base_s0, 1500 steps) with the EfficientViT-B1 student on the key-frame JPEG replacing the cached teacher outputs of the current frame (DualBEV and BEVFusion depth + context, and the depth the res4 lane branch lifts with); older frames keep the cached teacher outputs. Differences from t21_pair4: name, model.camera_student / student_init / student_trainable, lr_groups student 1e-5 (0.1 x lr), grad_clip_split += student, student_anchor 0.5 (loss scale: the t21 total is about 7.5 at the end, the student's own distillation total about 1.2, so the anchor is about 8 % of the total at the start and 0.8 % at its floor), floor 0.1, until 0.5 of the steps. The student is the A2 distillation checkpoint (student_init); BatchNorm stays in eval mode.
name: t22_B_s0
